kyraly.description: I work as a Full-Stack Developer, focusing on theme maintenance for platforms like Shopify, VTEX, and WordPress, as well as SEO and web performance optimization.

bulletPoints.shopifyDev: Development and maintenance of Shopify and WordPress features, focusing on SEO optimization and conversion rate increase (CRO).
bulletPoints.performance: Analysis and optimization of Core Web Vitals on various websites, promoting overall performance improvements. As a highlight, on an e-commerce category page, LCP was reduced from 21.3s to 3.6s through intelligent image loading prioritization and performance adjustments.
bulletPoints.automation: Creation of Python automations using Selenium and Pandas for content management and updating.
bulletPoints.wordpress: Implementation of manageable features in WordPress themes, with PHP and Advanced Custom Fields (ACF) integration.
bulletPoints.shopifyCustom: Development and customization of native Shopify themes with Liquid, adding new features and controls to the customization interface.
bulletPoints.seoOptimization: Maintenance and optimization of SEO and CRO on platforms like Next.js, Laravel, and VTEX, integrated with WordPress via REST API or GraphQL.
